Third-party license notices: d3-array, d3-format, d3-scale and d3-scale-chromatic
==============================================================================

DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.VegaLite contains ports of numeric algorithms of the
d3-array, d3-format and d3-scale packages (tick generation, tick step
selection, domain extension to round values ("nice"), number formatting, tick
label formats and the linear, band, point and ordinal scales) and the category
color values of the d3-scale-chromatic / Vega palette tableau10, which are
released under the ISC License. The license text of each package is reproduced
below exactly as published in the package repositories
(https://github.com/d3/d3-array, https://github.com/d3/d3-format,
https://github.com/d3/d3-scale and https://github.com/d3/d3-scale-chromatic).

This project is not affiliated with, and is not endorsed or promoted by, the
D3 project or its authors.
